commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
90+6' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Miro Muheim (Hamburger), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+5' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' Otto Stange (Hamburger) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hamburger SV are going to take it.
90+2' Here is a change. Fabio Vieira is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Philip Otele (Hamburger).
90+1' Tobias Welz blows his whistle. Fabio Balde (Hamburger) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is coming onto the pitch as Jakub Kaminski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
87' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
84' The game has come to an end for Tom Krauss. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Felipe Chavez (1. FC Koln).
83' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' FC Koln enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
81' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
79' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Balde (Hamburger) replacing William Mikelbrencis.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) will replace Jordan Torunarigha.
77' The game is interrupted now, William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' A yellow card for a tackle by Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln). Tobias Welz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' That's the end of the game for Ragnar Ache, who is replaced by Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln).
74' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Said El Mala will be replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
73' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
71' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Tobias Welz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) and blew his whistle.
69' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:8.
68' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) sends a long ball forward to Jean-Luc Dompe, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
67' Merlin Polzin has decided to substitute Damion Downs and he is replaced by Otto Stange (Hamburger).
66' Substitution. Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) on for Ransford Konigsdorffer.
65' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) takes it short.
65' A lofted pass picks out Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. FC Koln win a corner.
63' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
62' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
59' Tobias Welz blows his whistle as Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
58' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
58' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. FC Koln will take a corner kick.
57' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:9.
55' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
55' The ball falls kindly for Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
54' Warmed Omari (Hamburger) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
53' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

52' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.
51' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
50' Damion Downs (Hamburger) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
48' The FC Koln players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Linton Maina comes on the pitch for Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 1 Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) gets on the scoresheet with a sweet header that goes inside the right post!
45' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) will deliver the corner kick.

45' Great save! Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Daniel Heuer Fernandes. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
42' Neat passing move from FC Koln in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) for a tough tackle.
39' 1 - 0 GOAL! Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Marvin Schwabe, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
38' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
36' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Welz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

35' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
34' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marvin Schwabe, who smothers the ball.
33' Hamburger SV are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
32' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
31' Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' The resulting corner from Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

28' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
28' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) takes the corner with a short pass.

27' The ball is cleared after Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
26' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. FC Koln win a corner kick.
24' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
22' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Foul! Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
17' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Tobias Welz immediately signals a free kick.
16' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
14' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
12' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
8' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' FC Koln seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Hamburger SV.
2' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! FC Koln will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz is the one to supervise the game today.
